heading: INT. DEVEREAUX NATURAL HISTORY MUSEUM, TAXIDERMY HALL - AFTER HOURS

units.text: INT. DEVEREAUX NATURAL HISTORY MUSEUM, TAXIDERMY HALL - AFTER HOURS
Glass cases in long, shadowed rows: a snarling bear, a heron on one leg, a family of foxes frozen mid-pounce.
A moth circles the one working lamp.
Dust lies in a fine gray veil across everything.
MONTAGUE FINCH, sixties, the museum director, stands under the lamp with a gold pocket watch in his hand and a smudge of dust on his cuff.
PHILIPPA HOLT, forties, a private detective in a green overcoat, kneels beside the heron's case, shining a penlight on the lock.
DASHIELL WREN, thirties, the night guard, stands in the doorway with a baton and a sour expression.
XIMENA ROJAS, twenties, the intern, clutches a sheaf of loan forms against her chest.
LUDO PETRIE, fifties, the taxidermist, sits on a stool in the corner with a sleeve of his cardigan unraveling in his fingers.
The lock wasn't forced.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: Then someone had a key.
units.name: MONTAGUE

units.text: Only three keys exist. Mine. Mr. Finch's. And the taxidermist's.
units.name: DASHIELL

units.text: Mine's in my pocket.
units.name: LUDO

units.text: He proves it by pulling out a ring, jingling it, and returning it.
Montague turns his watch over in his palm.
Philippa lifts the lid of the case, takes out a single feather with a pair of tweezers, and holds it up to the lamp.
Dashiell shifts his weight and reaches for a handkerchief.
Ximena sets the loan forms on a bench, then picks them up again, as though they might be needed.
Ludo winds the loose thread of his cardigan around his finger until it goes white.
This isn't a heron feather. It's from an ibis.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: I beg your pardon?
units.name: MONTAGUE

units.text: Someone swapped the specimen. The ibis is worth forty times the heron.
units.name: PHILIPPA

units.text: I catalogued it last month. It was an ibis, in case nine.
units.name: XIMENA

units.text: Case nine is empty.
units.name: DASHIELL

units.text: It was never empty.
units.name: LUDO

units.text: Everyone turns to look at him.
He lets the thread fall.
